name: QuerySome
description: This function calls a given closure/function with every element in a given query and returns true, if one of the closure calls returns true.
syntax: QuerySome( query query, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
function/closure that implements the following constructor  
`function(struct row [, number rowNumber, query query]):boolean`.

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
